features.feature_name: Deployment Manager Cloud Scheduler type support
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the Cloud Scheduler resource type `gcp-types/cloudscheduler-v1:projects.locations.jobs`.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the Cloud Scheduler resource type `gcp-types/cloudscheduler-v1:projects.locations.jobs`.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the `gcp-types/compute-v1:externalVpnGateways` type to create Compute Engine ExternalVpnGateway resources.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the `gcp-types/compute-v1:externalVpnGateways` type to create Compute Engine ExternalVpnGateway resources.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the `gcp-types/compute-v1:vpnGateways` type to create Compute Engine VpnGateway resources.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the `gcp-types/compute-v1:vpnGateways` type to create Compute Engine VpnGateway resources.

features.feature_name: Cloud Resource Manager IAM mappings in Deployment Manager
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added a Cloud Resource Manager v1 type provider to create IAM mappings for projects and organizations.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added a Cloud Resource Manager v1 type provider to create IAM mappings for projects and organizations.

features.feature_name: Cloud Pub/Sub label updates in Deployment Manager
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager gained the ability to update labels for Cloud Pub/Sub resources.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager gained the ability to update labels for Cloud Pub/Sub resources.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager Redis API type support
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the Redis v1 API via the `gcp-types/redis-v1` type provider.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the Redis v1 API via the `gcp-types/redis-v1` type provider.

features.feature_name: Private Catalog support for Deployment Manager templates
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager templates became usable within Google Cloud Private Catalog.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager templates became usable within Google Cloud Private Catalog.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager Access Context Manager support
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for Access Context Manager v1beta via the `gcp-types/accesscontextmanager-v1beta` type provider.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for Access Context Manager v1beta via the `gcp-types/accesscontextmanager-v1beta` type provider.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager Cloud DNS RecordSets support
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for Cloud DNS v1 RecordSets using the `gcp-types/dns-v1:resourceRecordSets` type provider.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for Cloud DNS v1 RecordSets using the `gcp-types/dns-v1:resourceRecordSets` type provider.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager template username environment variable
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added a `username` template environment variable available in Python and Jinja templates.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added a `username` template environment variable available in Python and Jinja templates.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager Cloud Resource Manager folder management support
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager expanded support for creating and acquiring project folders using the `gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v2:folders` type provider.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager expanded support for creating and acquiring project folders using the `gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v2:folders` type provider.

features.feature_name: Glob import support in gcloud Deployment Manager templates
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager gained glob pattern support in gcloud for importing templates using wildcard template paths.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager gained glob pattern support in gcloud for importing templates using wildcard template paths.

features.feature_summary: Added a CREATE policy option for new deployment resources so creation fails when the resource already exists.
features.extended_definition: Added a CREATE policy option for new deployment resources so creation fails when the resource already exists.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager appengine.v1beta4 resource type support
features.feature_summary: Support for the appengine.v1beta4 resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2018-04-24.
features.extended_definition: Support for the appengine.v1beta4 resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2018-04-24.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager appengine.v1beta5 resource type support
features.feature_summary: Support for the appengine.v1beta5 resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2018-04-24.
features.extended_definition: Support for the appengine.v1beta5 resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2018-04-24.

features.feature_summary: Added a --template flag to support creating deployments from templates.
features.extended_definition: Added a --template flag to support creating deployments from templates.

features.feature_name: gcloud Deployment Manager composite type deployments
features.feature_summary: Updated gcloud so deployments can be created directly using composite types.
features.extended_definition: Updated gcloud so deployments can be created directly using composite types.

features.feature_summary: Added support for labels on Deployment Manager deployments.
features.extended_definition: Added support for labels on Deployment Manager deployments.

features.feature_summary: Added the returnValues query parameter to variables().list to return variable values for callers with runtimeconfig.variables.get permission.
features.extended_definition: Added the returnValues query parameter to variables().list to return variable values for callers with runtimeconfig.variables.get permission.

features.feature_summary: Added a new project_number environment variable.
features.extended_definition: Added a new project_number environment variable.

features.feature_summary: Introduced the Type Registry feature, allowing users to add composite types and third-party APIs as type providers.
features.extended_definition: Introduced the Type Registry feature, allowing users to add composite types and third-party APIs as type providers.

features.feature_summary: Moved Runtime Configurator gcloud commands to the gcloud beta component.
features.extended_definition: Moved Runtime Configurator gcloud commands to the gcloud beta component.

features.feature_name: Runtime Configurator gcloud command group namespace
features.feature_summary: Updated Runtime Configurator gcloud commands so the command group is now under the runtime-config namespace.
features.extended_definition: Updated Runtime Configurator gcloud commands so the command group is now under the runtime-config namespace.

features.feature_summary: Added gcloud command-line support for creating plaintext variable values.
features.extended_definition: Added gcloud command-line support for creating plaintext variable values.

features.feature_summary: Updated gcloud --properties flag syntax to accept key:value pairs while keeping key=value supported.
features.extended_definition: Updated gcloud --properties flag syntax to accept key:value pairs while keeping key=value supported.

features.feature_summary: Added documentation for configuring Deployment Manager to use images from another project.
features.extended_definition: Added documentation for configuring Deployment Manager to use images from another project.

features.feature_name: Runtime Configurator API plaintext variable creation
features.feature_summary: Added API support for creating variables with plaintext values in Runtime Configurator.
features.extended_definition: Added API support for creating variables with plaintext values in Runtime Configurator.

features.feature_summary: Added an optional requestId field to Runtime Configurator create() requests for request uniqueness.
features.extended_definition: Added an optional requestId field to Runtime Configurator create() requests for request uniqueness.

features.feature_name: IAM policy support in Deployment Manager configurations
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager gained the ability to specify IAM policies directly within deployment configurations.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager gained the ability to specify IAM policies directly within deployment configurations.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for using predefined IAM roles in the beta release.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for using predefined IAM roles in the beta release.

features.feature_name: Runtime Configurator quota model and request quotas
features.feature_summary: Runtime Configurator quotas were changed to be based on data per user with updated default values, and API request quotas were updated.
features.extended_definition: Runtime Configurator quotas were changed to be based on data per user with updated default values, and API request quotas were updated.

features.feature_name: Runtime Configurator variable value size limits
features.feature_summary: Runtime Configurator removed the 4 KB limit on variable values.
features.extended_definition: Runtime Configurator removed the 4 KB limit on variable values.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for hosting templates from Google Cloud Storage or other publicly accessible URLs.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for hosting templates from Google Cloud Storage or other publicly accessible URLs.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager introduced outputs so configuration properties can be exposed for downstream use.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager introduced outputs so configuration properties can be exposed for downstream use.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added schema support to define validation rules for using templates.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added schema support to define validation rules for using templates.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the new cluster.v1.cluster resource type.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the new cluster.v1.cluster resource type.

features.feature_summary: Support for the cluster.v1beta1.cluster resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2015-11-04.
features.extended_definition: Support for the cluster.v1beta1.cluster resource type in Deployment Manager was removed; deprecated on 2015-11-04.

features.feature_name: Cloud Deployment Manager v2 API general availability
features.feature_summary: Cloud Deployment Manager was made generally available with the v2 API for all users and projects.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Deployment Manager was made generally available with the v2 API for all users and projects.

features.feature_summary: The intent and state properties were removed from Deployment resources; deprecated on 2015-07-22.
features.extended_definition: The intent and state properties were removed from Deployment resources; deprecated on 2015-07-22.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager cancel-preview and stop subcommands
features.feature_summary: The deployments cancel subcommand was replaced by the new cancel-preview and stop command subcommands.
features.extended_definition: The deployments cancel subcommand was replaced by the new cancel-preview and stop command subcommands.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager now requires deployment fingerprints when updating, canceling, or stopping a deployment.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager now requires deployment fingerprints when updating, canceling, or stopping a deployment.

features.feature_summary: The Deployment Manager manifest structure was updated to show templates explicitly in a dedicated imports section.
features.extended_definition: The Deployment Manager manifest structure was updated to show templates explicitly in a dedicated imports section.

features.feature_summary: A new boolean preview query parameter was added to the Deployment Manager API for previewing deployments.
features.extended_definition: A new boolean preview query parameter was added to the Deployment Manager API for previewing deployments.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager stop and cancelPreview API methods
features.feature_summary: New stop and cancelPreview custom methods were added to the Deployment Manager API.
features.extended_definition: New stop and cancelPreview custom methods were added to the Deployment Manager API.

features.feature_summary: The PATCH update policy option was removed from the Deployment Manager API; deprecated on 2015-07-22.
features.extended_definition: The PATCH update policy option was removed from the Deployment Manager API; deprecated on 2015-07-22.

features.feature_summary: The --update-policy flag was removed because PATCH update operations were no longer supported; deprecated on 2015-07-22.
features.extended_definition: The --update-policy flag was removed because PATCH update operations were no longer supported; deprecated on 2015-07-22.

features.feature_name: Deployment Manager unlimited delete and read quotas
features.feature_summary: Quota limits were updated so delete and read requests in Deployment Manager are now unlimited.
features.extended_definition: Quota limits were updated so delete and read requests in Deployment Manager are now unlimited.

features.feature_summary: A new updateTime field was added to Deployment Manager.
features.extended_definition: A new updateTime field was added to Deployment Manager.

features.feature_summary: Cloud Deployment Manager was launched in Beta.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Deployment Manager was launched in Beta.

features.feature_name: Cloud Deployment Manager v2beta2 manifest layouts
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager v2beta2 included new manifest layout capabilities.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager v2beta2 included new manifest layout capabilities.

features.feature_name: Cloud Deployment Manager v2beta2 server-side expansion
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager v2beta2 introduced server-side expansion capabilities.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager v2beta2 introduced server-side expansion capabilities.

features.feature_name: Cloud Deployment Manager v2beta2 update capabilities
features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager v2beta2 added update capabilities for deployments.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager v2beta2 added update capabilities for deployments.

features.feature_summary: Support for external references in Deployment Manager was disabled; Support for external references was added to Deployment Manager; deprecated on 2015-02-20.
features.extended_definition: Support for external references in Deployment Manager was disabled; Support for external references was added to Deployment Manager; deprecated on 2015-02-20.

features.feature_name: Cloud Deployment Manager HTTP load-balanced deployment tutorial
features.feature_summary: Added a new tutorial for creating HTTP load-balanced deployments in Cloud Deployment Manager.
features.extended_definition: Added a new tutorial for creating HTTP load-balanced deployments in Cloud Deployment Manager.

features.feature_summary: Deployment Manager added support for the Google Container Engine cluster type container.v1beta1.cluster for declaring and deploying clusters.
features.extended_definition: Deployment Manager added support for the Google Container Engine cluster type container.v1beta1.cluster for declaring and deploying clusters.
